notes: Values collected but never saved by the mockup are now persisted: 02 uploaded prosecutor-opinion scan and 13 second final-doc copy go into attachment; 18 EMS slip/hand-receipt scans go into attachment; 19 the actual OAG verdict PDF goes into attachment (mockup only kept an autofill label); 22 all prosecutorResult* fields and in_notifySubject go into case_closure.

Send-back overwrite loops (06<->07, 06<->08) are fixed with opinion_draft_version (version_no per redraft) and opinion_review (round_no matching the draft it reviewed), instead of overwriting a single set of columns; case_transition records every SUBMIT/RETURN action so the full history is queryable. The intended-but-unimplemented return routing on 14/15 (final_doc_review) still always advances the case forward, per the mockup; this is documented, not silently fixed, since fixing routing is a business decision outside DB scope.

Added an explicit opinion_type lookup (AGREE/DISSENT/OTHER) used by opinion_draft_version.opinion_type_code and final_opinion_doc.opinion_type_code, because the mockup only stores a rendered Thai phrase and routing on page 18/19 relies on a fragile 'เห็นชอบ' substring match against finalOpinionType.

All business dates are stored as ISO date/timestamptz columns even where the mockup only produced a Thai display string (e.g. signedDate, boardMeetingDate, adminDispatchDate, groupDirectorApprovedDate) -- Thai formatting is UI-only.

Board meeting/resolution data (board_resolution) and the executive signature (executive_sign, rounds 1 and 2) have no real entry screen in the mockup -- they are fabricated inside signExecutiveRound1/2 -- but are still modelled as first-class tables per the brief, since a real system needs to capture them; executive_sign also has no signature image/certificate captured for either round (only a confirm dialog), unlike the other seven signature events which go through the shared signature modal.

The 9 OAG verdict case types (oag_verdict_case_type) are modelled as a lookup with an outcome_code FK to oag_verdict_decision (PROSECUTE/NON_PROSECUTE); code 9 (อื่นๆ) has a null default outcome_code because the mockup lets the user choose the outcome manually via in_oagVerdictOtherOutcome, captured as oag_verdict_intake.decision_code.

offenseBases[] and dispatchRecipients[] are modelled as true child tables (offense_basis, dispatch_recipient) rather than JSON columns, per the brief; offense_basis.round_no distinguishes the original intake set (02, round_no=0) from any officer edit during opinion drafting (06, round_no=opinion_draft_version.version_no).

externalDispatchNo (page 17) and finalDocNo (page 13, constant) are hard-coded string literals in the mockup with no input control; they are still modelled as normal fields on admin_signed_receive/final_opinion_doc and mirrored into document_number, since a production system would make them real sequence-issued numbers.

Tables were consolidated by step_code/round_no where the mockup's pages are structurally repeats of the same shape (assignment for 04/05; admin_dispatch for 09/16; executive_sign for exec rounds 1/2; resolution_order for 10/11/12; final_doc_review for 14/15; oag_verdict_review for 20/21) to keep the schema near the brief's 15-30 table target (30 tables total: 21 case-data tables + 9 lookup tables) while still separating every page's fields via step_code.
